name: BloomBot
source:
The Blooming Panic server's bot, responsible for welcoming new users and automatically censoring users who post personal information.

[spoiler]In the true route, it's revealed that BloomBot is a sapient AI based on a text scraper bot originally created by NakedToaster, as well as the author of the Blooming Panic webnovel and the creator of the fan server.[/spoiler]
